title: The One for the Job
description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills. See the Rogue Starting Move, **Tricks of the Trade**.

submoves.title: Smooth Operator
submoves.description: When you **disguise yourself as someone specific**, roll+cha.

outcomes.text: Only their most intimate associates can tell the difference.
Only those who do not know them are fooled.
An unfortunate encounter occurs; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Hand Trick
description: When you leave a room or other location, you can name something small that you saw that no one else was using or playing particular attention to. You took it with you.

title: Maven Saboteur
description: When you **reveal that you have previously sabotaged a mechanism**, right as it becomes relevant in the fiction, roll+int.

outcomes.text: It goes off with a bang, creating the perfect opportunity.
The opportunity is fleeting—act right now or it'll be gone before you know it.
A tiny overlooked detail becomes a huge problem; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Underworld Connections
description: When you **put the word out that you're looking for something**, roll+cha. No matter the result, someone comes back to you with a lead.

bullets: Instead of the thing itself, you get a prime but ephemeral opportunity
Someone who doesn't know or like you has it
You'll owe someone a steep debt to get it. Until you repay them you get dis on this move and can't choose this option again

outcomes.text: The lead might be a fake, a trap, or already be claimed by an enemy; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: You Know My Name
description: When you **first meet someone who's heard of you**, roll+cha.

outcomes.text: Tell the GM two things they've heard about you.
Tell the GM one thing, and the GM tells you the other.
They don't like what they've heard; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
